// Generator of go-oracle.json: what discovery.Discover of the freeze commit
// (238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8) finds for every project under
// testdata/projects/ and for the inline projects below, and what
// ResolveTestScript says for the script tables of the Go tests. Kept as
// text; regenerate from the repository root with:
//
//	mkdir -p dev/zzdiscoveryoracle && cp internal/discovery/testdata/go-oracle.go.txt dev/zzdiscoveryoracle/main.go
//	go run ./dev/zzdiscoveryoracle > internal/discovery/testdata/go-oracle.json && rm -r dev/zzdiscoveryoracle
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/discovery"
)

func main() {
	type projectOut struct {
		Name   string            `json:"name"`
		Files  map[string][]byte `json:"files,omitempty"` // base64 in JSON
		Result any               `json:"result"`
	}
	var projects []projectOut
	entries, err := os.ReadDir("testdata/projects")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	for _, e := range entries {
		if !e.IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		p, err := discovery.Discover(filepath.Join("testdata/projects", e.Name()))
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		projects = append(projects, projectOut{Name: "testdata/projects/" + e.Name(), Result: dumpProject(p)})
	}
	for _, c := range inline {
		root, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "oracle")
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		for rel, content := range c.files {
			p := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
		}
		p, err := discovery.Discover(root)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		raw := map[string][]byte{}
		for rel, content := range c.files {
			raw[rel] = []byte(content)
		}
		projects = append(projects, projectOut{Name: c.name, Files: raw, Result: dumpProject(p)})
		os.RemoveAll(root)
	}
	type scriptOut struct {
		Scripts map[string]string `json:"scripts"`
		Result  any               `json:"result"`
	}
	var chains []scriptOut
	for _, s := range scripts {
		chains = append(chains, scriptOut{s, dumpTests(discovery.ResolveTestScript(s))})
	}
	out := map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "discovery of the freeze commit 238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8 (Go 1.27.3)",
		"projects":     projects,
		"scripts":      chains,
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	enc.SetIndent("", " ")
	if err := enc.Encode(out); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

// pairs renders a map as [key, value] pairs sorted by key; nil stays null.
func pairs(m map[string]string) any {
	if m == nil {
		return nil
	}
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(m))
	for k := range m {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	out := [][]string{}
	for _, k := range keys {
		out = append(out, []string{k, m[k]})
	}
	return out
}

func list[T any](s []T) []T {
	if s == nil {
		return []T{}
	}
	return s
}

func unsupported(u *discovery.Unsupported) any {
	if u == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return map[string]string{"code": u.Code, "reason": u.Reason}
}

func dumpTests(t *discovery.TestSetup) any {
	if t == nil {
		return nil
	}
	var suites []any
	for _, s := range t.Suites {
		suites = append(suites, map[string]any{
			"runner": s.Runner, "args": list(s.Args), "env": pairs(s.Env), "dropped": s.Dropped, "origin": s.Origin,
		})
	}
	var left []any
	for _, l := range t.LeftOut {
		left = append(left, []string{l.Step, l.Script})
	}
	return map[string]any{"script": t.Script, "suites": list(suites), "unsupported": unsupported(t.Unsupported), "leftOut": list(left)}
}

func dumpFiles(files []discovery.File) any {
	out := []any{}
	for _, f := range files {
		out = append(out, []string{f.Path, f.PackageRel, string(f.Class), f.ContextID})
	}
	return out
}

func dumpProject(p *discovery.Project) any {
	var pkgs []any
	for _, pkg := range p.Packages {
		var gens []any
		for _, g := range pkg.GeneratorScripts {
			gens = append(gens, map[string]any{"name": g.Name, "env": pairs(g.Env), "file": g.File, "args": list(g.Args)})
		}
		var refs []any
		for _, r := range pkg.ServiceRefs {
			refs = append(refs, map[string]any{"service": r.Service, "file": r.File, "line": r.Line})
		}
		pkgs = append(pkgs, map[string]any{
			"path": pkg.Path, "contextID": pkg.ContextID, "buildStepReason": pkg.BuildStepReason,
			"npmLockfile": pkg.NPMLockfile, "manager": string(pkg.Manager),
			"installUnsupported": unsupported(pkg.InstallUnsupported),
			"nodeChoice": map[string]any{
				"version": pkg.NodeChoice.Version, "source": pkg.NodeChoice.Source, "variant": pkg.NodeChoice.Variant,
				"notChecked": list(pkg.NodeChoice.NotChecked), "unsupported": unsupported(pkg.NodeChoice.Unsupported),
			},
			"tests": dumpTests(pkg.Tests), "mochaDependency": pkg.MochaDependency, "usesMocha": pkg.UsesMocha(),
			"generatorScripts": list(gens), "serviceRefs": list(refs), "files": dumpFiles(pkg.Files),
		})
	}
	var contexts []any
	for _, c := range p.Contexts {
		contexts = append(contexts, c.Context)
	}
	var services []any
	for _, s := range p.Services {
		services = append(services, map[string]any{
			"name": s.Name, "file": s.File, "declared": s.Declared, "family": s.Family,
			"notStarted": unsupported(s.NotStarted), "env": pairs(s.Env), "unresolved": list(s.Unresolved),
			"versionDiffers": s.VersionDiffers,
		})
	}
	var problems []any
	for _, pr := range p.ComposeProblems {
		problems = append(problems, []string{pr.Path, pr.Reason})
	}
	return map[string]any{
		"packages": list(pkgs), "contexts": list(contexts), "files": dumpFiles(p.Files),
		"services": list(services), "dotEnv": pairs(p.DotEnv), "composeProblems": list(problems),
	}
}
